author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh dough, open flames, and one of the oldest bread-making methods still alive today 🍞🔥 In this video, we bake fresh bread directly over fire using an ancient village technique passed down through generations.

The bread develops a beautifully crisp crust while staying soft and airy inside, absorbing the natural smoky aroma from the fire. With simple ingredients and careful hands, this timeless method creates bread full of rustic flavor and warmth.

This is authentic village baking at its purest — no modern equipment, just fire, patience, and tradition. A simple yet unforgettable way of making bread that connects the past with the present.
title: Fresh Bread Cooked Over Fire – Ancient Village Technique 🍞🔥
